results.title: Айтматов
results.overview: An upcoming biopic on world-renowned Kyrgyz author Chingiz Aitmatov. The film traces his childhood, losing his father, and the personal struggle that shaped his literary voice—from humble beginnings to becoming the voice of his nation.

results.title: Time will tell
results.overview: Following the recent death of her mother and the unexpected return of her brother NICO (Sergio Romero), VAL (Hada Nieto) will have to confront the wounds of her past, which continue to haunt her present and prevent her from moving forward.

results.title: Friday the 69th
results.overview: Porn filmmakers in 1981 seek to cash in on the slasher craze by making their own independent ripoff that follows a group of spring breaking college coeds as they are stalked by a mysterious killer beekeeper at a camp with a tragic past.

results.title: VIVO 76: Alive in ‘76
results.overview: This work explores the culture and influences that shaped the creation and performance of the songs on Vivo!, the third album by Pernambuco-born singer-songwriter Alceu Valença, released in 1976. Through this album, it paints a portrait of the birth of Pernambuco’s psychedelic scene, ranging from its visual art and fantastical characters to the initial forays toward Rio de Janeiro and mainstream success. It is a journey back to the 1970s, viewed through the lens of today and the eyes of tomorrow.

results.title: To Catch A Siren
results.overview: A young refugee desperately searches for her mother, who she believes to be a mermaid.

results.title: My Kind of Christmas
results.overview: When ambitious assistant Lindsay must track down the season’s most sought-after toy to land a long-awaited promotion, she teams up with handsome widowed dad Erik on the same quest for his daughter. But as their practical mission turns into a heartwarming holiday journey, she’s forced to choose between the career she’s always chased and the unexpected joy of love, family, and Christmas magic!

results.title: Zvezda
results.overview: After graduating in London, the artist Zvezda has to return to Bulgaria to help her mother. She manages to arrange her first solo exhibition in a renowned Sofia gallery, but the dreamed opening triumph is canceled due to the Covid lock down.

results.title: Inside My Chest Lives a Dog
results.original_title: Dentro do Meu Peito Mora um Cão
results.overview: In a city exploited by mining, Josué can’t sleep. Surrounded by mountains, fears, and frustrations, he reflects incessantly on the challenges of early adulthood.

results.title: 52 Blue
results.overview: Isolated by his father, Ashish escapes home aged 23 with his mother's unwavering support to meet his idol, Messi, in the 2022 world cup in Qatar. Starting a journey that leads him to discover himself and the world for the first time.

results.title: The Squatters and the Fairy Princess
results.original_title: The Squatters and the Fairy Princess
results.overview: On her 10th birthday, a self-identified Fairy Princess recounts her previous birthdays that have all taken place in a house amongst eccentric squatters.

results.title: Aks seir
results.overview: Two young men struggling with financial pressure take jobs at a cash-in-transit company and devise a plan to rob it from the inside. But when their scheme spirals out of control, they find themselves caught in a chaotic chase where nothing goes according to plan.

results.title: The Sunsets in the West

results.title: Love Apptually
results.overview: Tired of swiping without results? Follow one journalist’s quest to unpack the dating app algorithms shaping modern romance as she reveals how, in an already lonely world, technology, bias and profit are increasingly influencing who we meet and why.

results.title: Charbel: The Movie
results.overview: When Youssef Makhlouf was born in 1828, the small northern Lebanese village of BeqaaKafra had no idea it was welcoming a future saint. Saint Charbel would go on to bless and heal people of all religions, all around the world. This is simply the biopic of Charbel, the Saint of all Saints!

results.title: Smarty
results.overview: Exiled director Nikita Lavretski (played by Belarusian director Sergey Kolosovski) strives to reunite with his wife across European borders. Reminiscing about the home he had to leave, he wonders whether he is stuck reliving his past forever.

results.title: Get Undressed
results.overview: After years without seeing each other, Tsumugi goes camping with her former track and field teammates. Their excitement at the reunion fades when a conflict they were never able to resolve resurfaces. What no one can imagine is that they're sleeping on the site of an ancient execution ground, where centuries ago villagers were crucified naked. At night, their spirits emerge to hunt down the campers. And then Tsumugi discovers the only way to survive: by undressing.
